evidence.name: Screen field: Fade over the media
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Fade over the media" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Fade over the media
sections.description: Lays a soft, see-through fade (usually dark) over the media so any text or button on top stays readable against a busy image. Turn it on whenever you place a title, subtitle, or button over the media; without it, light areas of the image can wash out your copy. When enabled, you get controls below to set the fade's height and color.
